stories.title: Launch HN: StarSling (YC P25) – Self-improving CI for agent-volume repos
summary: PRs are generated through our CI harness, which runs an agent loop that’s tuned to improve your CI speed and reduce cost.Mastra now merges over 1,800 PRs a month and we got their slowest workflow from 29m 56s on GitHub-hosted runners down to 5m 06s (5.87x) on StarSling.
We realized the true value of having an agent loop running on top of fast runners when our agents found an 11-month-old performance bottleneck in better-auth.
Our agents start opening PRs once you've hit about 10,000 minutes.Today we announced our CI Challenge: if StarSling can't save you at least 10% on your next CI bill, we'll literally give you $1,000.
